title: Prove minimum-query endpoint for the mutable-source connector
body:
The common-B mutable-source connector's paired-readout query minimum and equal-price tariff are known, but the unequal query/readout tradeoff remains open. This package proves its minimum-query endpoint for every n>=1: **n+1 queries**, and at that minimum exactly **(n+1)*2^(n-1) readouts** are necessary and attainable. The explicit word uses 2(n-1) paid source XORs; that XOR count is attained, not claimed optimal.

For five sources the word is **6 Q / 96 R / 8 X**. With a five-factor B and single-factor A_m, its fully counted abstract tariff is **436**, versus **508** for the least costly displayed predecessor (and 512 for PR1370's four-X word). Every inverse leaf, internal node, source XOR and root dispatch is charged. The old equal-Q/R tariff is also checked and gives no improvement.

Only `research/mutable-source-minimum-queries/` is added. Start with README.md for the exact common-B, arbitrary-dirty, temporarily unobserved-source contract and the all-n rank/even-subset proof. CERTIFICATE.json records the complete words; TASK/SOURCES/PREDECESSORS record the scope and pins. No pending executable is imported.

Validation on Windows / **CPython 3.12.14**, standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mutable-source-minimum-queries
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
```

The registered replay passes: symbolic dirty root/expanded/inverse checks, n=1..9 fixtures, all 168 GL3 prefix bases and 168 full-span circuits, 12 semantic controls, a second matrix oracle's **7,360** executions plus two concrete controls, and seven CLI/corruption/relocation/regeneration test groups. Source pins and selected-record verification pass. Default checks are read-only. The two implementations are by the same assisted author; no independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Scope selection: main `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43`; initial staging base `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`; after resumption, current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea` was merged. Revision-3 guidance was read, the existing assigned task retained per AGENTS.md, and all mathematical inputs and selected-record bytes are unchanged. Chooser nonce `edb6b50cf28c576de3f77fc578cfdfb4`, revision-2 recursive-interfaces, refined `connector-alphabet-change`. [Claim #1579](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1579). Final resumption overlap covers 542 open PRs including drafts and 528 Discussion/comment/reply records, with complete pagination; exact predecessor heads are rechecked. This follows PR1524's unequal-price handoff and differs from DUO/TRIO, two-root proposals, PR1770's read-only unequal-source tariff and PR1811's hyperplane-output families; no novelty guarantee follows from search absence.

Credit **Arham Tahir / PR1340** `f1dcab36fa63f8226f70dd07e26f44afb9d39b51` for the paid source-shear alphabet/paired-readout obstruction, **PR1370** `8a9b633879b5bfe03400a6c09c31bae7568e6261` for the four-X word/fixed-count bound; **TennisBowling / PR1524** `5c1f39788a0fc669b7e37e27785c63e85788c350` for the arbitrary-count equal-price theorem and handoff; **Ross Richardson / PR943/934** for the prefix framework/repairs/dirty lowering; **shhxera/CubeJerry / PR889** and **Chafik Boukhalfa / PR628** for retained batching/commutator lineage. The affine-basis technique itself is classical.

Open obligations: global unequal-price optimum (intermediate query counts may undercut this endpoint), minimum X count at six queries, and actual hosted physical prices/ownership/frame/precision/tape/outer-interface admission. No selected cold replay, supplier adoption, new moment/kappa, selected-frontier edit, full multiplication theorem, merge or closure is requested.

Prepared by **Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in proof, code, checking and writing; no subagents. Apache-2.0, with predecessor attribution retained.

PR1340 and PR1370 have since merged unchanged; PR1524 remains open. Their exact head and publication states are recorded separately. The updated main replay hook also passes.
